title: Prime Minister shares an article on India’s Blue Economy
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi has shared an article written by Union Minister of State Shri Jitendra Singh.
The article highlights India’s Blue Economy as a pathway to prosperity, sustainability and national strength. As part of the Sapta-Dhara vision, it brings together science, technology and enterprise to strengthen livelihoods, food and energy security and create new opportunities for youth.
The Prime Minister’s Office wrote on X;
“India's Blue Economy is emerging as a powerful pathway to prosperity, sustainability and national strength, writes Union MoS @DrJitendraSingh.
As part of the Sapta-Dhara vision, it brings together science, technology and enterprise to strengthen livelihoods, food and energy security and create new opportunities for youth.”
India's Blue Economy is emerging as a powerful pathway to prosperity, sustainability and national strength, writes Union MoS @DrJitendraSingh.
